plan_name: SHS Launch Gate Hardening Plan V1

hardening_items.name: Durable launch/signoff/version ledger
hardening_items.current_state: Launch, signoff, version, and ClientOps activation evidence is documented in runbooks and local/internal flows, but no durable SHRV1 ledger exists.
hardening_items.required_future_state: Create a durable launch ledger that records launch ID, project ID, client ID, signoff records, version baseline, rollback plan, ClientOps activation status, timestamps, owners, exceptions, and immutable export/version references.
hardening_items.definition_of_done: Launch records persist locally in SHRV1 V1 storage, expose deterministic read/write endpoints, include signoff/version/rollback fields, and are covered by focused tests and governance checks.

hardening_items.name: SHRV1 Launch Gate route/model
hardening_items.current_state: No dedicated SHRV1 Launch Gate route or runtime model was found; launch is an operator process spanning Production Ops, QA, Reports, Truth Spine, and SHF-Next ClientOps.
hardening_items.required_future_state: Add an admin-only Launch Gate surface that lists launch candidates, shows readiness, captures launch records, and blocks launch completion until required evidence is present.
hardening_items.definition_of_done: Admin route loads, is sidebar-discoverable, is restricted to intended admin/operator roles, shows launch readiness, and writes only to the launch gate model without changing public surfaces.

hardening_items.name: Operator signoff
hardening_items.current_state: Operator signoff is required by runbooks but remains manual and lacks a hard field, timestamp, owner, or exception ledger.
hardening_items.required_future_state: Require operator signoff with owner, role, timestamp, status, notes, exception acknowledgement, and verification that route smoke, leakage, build packet, QA, and governance checks are complete.
hardening_items.definition_of_done: A launch record cannot reach launch-ready status without completed operator signoff metadata and visible exception status.

hardening_items.name: QA signoff
hardening_items.current_state: QA criteria are defined and SHF-Next validates QA record, 100 percent score, and no critical blockers before ClientOps conversion; SHRV1 does not yet attach durable QA signoff evidence to a launch record.
hardening_items.required_future_state: Attach QA signoff evidence to the launch record, including QA owner, score, blocker status, checklist reference, screenshot QA status, build status, and approved exceptions.
hardening_items.definition_of_done: Launch readiness shows QA status and prevents paid-launch-ready state unless QA evidence is complete or formally exception-approved.

hardening_items.name: Delivery signoff
hardening_items.current_state: Delivery Ready exists as QA/ClientOps context, but delivery signoff is not a durable SHRV1 launch gate field.
hardening_items.required_future_state: Require delivery signoff confirming client-facing content/assets, handoff guide, build packet, support tier, and open blocker disposition.
hardening_items.definition_of_done: Delivery signoff fields are required before paid-launch-ready status and show complete, blocked, or exception-approved state.

hardening_items.name: Client signoff
hardening_items.current_state: Client signoff is required by Phase 6 runbook but currently operator-recorded and not hard-enforced.
hardening_items.required_future_state: Require client signoff status, signer, date, approved exceptions, and client-facing notes before paid launch readiness.
hardening_items.definition_of_done: Paid-launch-ready state is blocked unless client signoff is signed off or signed off with explicitly approved exceptions.

hardening_items.name: Rollback requirement
hardening_items.current_state: Rollback requirements are documented in the launch audit, but no rollback owner, trigger, last-known-good version, communication plan, or recovery note is required at runtime.
hardening_items.required_future_state: Make rollback plan required for launch readiness, including rollback owner, trigger conditions, last known good version, affected routes/modules, preservation note, client communication note, support escalation path, and post-rollback review owner.
hardening_items.definition_of_done: Launch record cannot be marked launch-ready unless rollback plan fields are present or the launch is explicitly marked rehearsal-only.

hardening_items.name: ClientOps activation gate
hardening_items.current_state: SHF-Next ClientOps conversion is near-ready and validates QA readiness, but activation remains local/internal and is not represented as durable SHRV1 launch-gate evidence.
hardening_items.required_future_state: Add ClientOps activation state to launch records, including ClientOps record ID, owner, support tier, launch date, version baseline, maintenance/watch transfer, reports/routes/modules, and activation timestamp.
hardening_items.definition_of_done: Launch Gate records whether ClientOps is active, links to the internal ClientOps surface, and blocks paid launch until activation evidence is present.

hardening_items.name: Support owner required
hardening_items.current_state: Support tier is present in runbooks and SHF-Next QA/ClientOps context, but support owner is not clearly hard-required in the current data model.
hardening_items.required_future_state: Require support owner or ClientOps owner before ClientOps Active and paid launch readiness.
hardening_items.definition_of_done: Launch and ClientOps activation records expose support owner and reject paid-launch-ready status when owner is missing.

hardening_items.name: Launch version record
hardening_items.current_state: SHF-Next ClientOps creates a basic v1-launch version history entry; launch audit requires richer launch version metadata and approval/signoff references.
hardening_items.required_future_state: Require launch version record with version ID, launch date, project/client IDs, package, active modules, routes, reports, known exceptions, support tier, launch owner, rollback note, and approval reference.
hardening_items.definition_of_done: Every launch record includes a complete version baseline and the UI clearly displays missing version fields before launch readiness.

hardening_items.name: Paid launch readiness gate
hardening_items.current_state: Private-beta go/no-go is documented, but no single runtime status computes paid launch readiness from approvals, rollback, ClientOps activation, Truth/Reports readiness, and persistence/auth assumptions.
hardening_items.required_future_state: Add deterministic readiness calculation that separates rehearsal-ready, private-beta-ready, and paid-launch-ready states and blocks paid launch when required evidence, auth, persistence, public approval, report readiness, or ClientOps activation is incomplete.
hardening_items.definition_of_done: Paid launch readiness is computed from required fields, exposes exact blockers, appears in Reports/Watchtower context if safe, and is covered by tests.

private_beta_go_no_go: GO for supervised private beta launch rehearsal. HARDEN BEFORE UNSUPERVISED PRIVATE BETA: ledger, launch route/model, operator signoff, QA signoff, rollback, and version record.
paid_launch_go_no_go: NO-GO for paid launch until all paid-launch-required hardening items are complete and production auth/session plus durable persistence assumptions are resolved.
